For the diene reactivity (B), the order is based on their ability to adopt the s-cis conformation required for Diels-Alder reactions. Cyclopenta-1,3-diene (3) is locked in the s-cis conformation and is the most reactive. 2,3-Dimethylbuta-1,3-diene (1) is a terminal diene that easily adopts s-cis and is electron-rich. (2E,4E)-Hexa-2,4-diene (2) is an internal diene that must overcome steric hindrance to achieve s-cis. (2Z,4Z)-Hexa-2,4-diene (4) is twisted out of planarity due to steric hindrance and is the least reactive. The correct sequence is 3 > 1 > 2 > 4.
